gitCommit.subject: fix(chat): key the user list rooms by playUri instead of room name (#6548)
gitCommit.body:
fix(chat): key the user list rooms by playUri instead of room name (#6548)

The rooms `{#each}` in RoomUserList was keyed on the displayed room name.
Two different playUris can render the same label — the same map name served
under two domains, for instance — so switching between the chat and the user
list crashed with `each_key_duplicate`.

Key on the playUri instead, which is the key of the `usersByRoomStore` Map and
therefore unique by construction. `shownRoomListStore` now tracks playUris too,
so homonymous rooms expand independently and the expanded state survives a
language change.

Co-authored-by: yannisdia <y.diarra@workadventu.re>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
(cherry picked from commit bd44f3110352fb22343ab4c1b5eeabfd7c27b4f5)
